request: what is the chance of getting heads and a six when you flip a coin and roll a dice?

beats.intent: Coin outcomes H and T down the side, dice outcomes 1 to 6 along the top
beats.narration: Flip a coin and roll a dice. The coin gives heads or tails; the dice gives one to six.
beats.code:
stage.title("Heads and a six")
w, h = 0.8, 0.7
tl = np.array([-5.6, 1.6, 0])
cell = lambda r, c: tl + np.array([(c + 0.5) * w, -(r + 0.5) * h, 0])
tops = VGroup(*[Text(str(c), font_size=28, color=BLUE).move_to(cell(0, c)) for c in range(1, 7)])
sides = VGroup(*[Text(t, font_size=28, color=ORANGE).move_to(cell(r, 0)) for r, t in ((1, "H"), (2, "T"))])
stage.play(FadeIn(tops), FadeIn(sides))
stage.add(tops, sides)

beats.intent: A 2 by 6 grid of all 12 equally likely outcomes, H1 to T6
beats.narration: Every pairing is equally likely: two times six, twelve outcomes.
beats.code:
grid = VGroup(*[VGroup(Rectangle(width=w, height=h, color=GREY_B, stroke_width=2), Text(f"{'HT'[r - 1]}{c}", font_size=22)).move_to(cell(r, c)) for r in (1, 2) for c in range(1, 7)])
stage.play(LaggedStart(*[FadeIn(g) for g in grid], lag_ratio=0.05))
stage.add(grid)
stage.label(grid, "12 outcomes", direction=DOWN)

beats.narration: Only one of them is heads and a six.
beats.code:
hit = grid[5]
stage.play(hit[0].animate.set_fill(GREEN, opacity=0.6).set_stroke(GREEN))
stage.label(hit, "1 of 12", direction=RIGHT, color=GREEN)

beats.narration: The coin doesn't affect the dice, so multiply the chances: a half times a sixth, one twelfth.

request: how does a frequency tree sort 200 people?

beats.intent: A top box for all 200 people
beats.code:
stage.title("A frequency tree")
node = lambda t, p, col=WHITE: VGroup(RoundedRectangle(width=1.5, height=0.6, corner_radius=0.12, color=col), Text(t, font_size=24, color=col)).move_to(p)
root = node("200", [-3.2, 2.0, 0])
stage.play(FadeIn(root))
stage.add(root)
stage.label(root, "people", direction=RIGHT)

beats.narration: A hundred and twenty are adults and eighty are children.
beats.code:
ad = node("120", [-5.0, 0.4, 0], BLUE)
ch = node("80", [-1.4, 0.4, 0], ORANGE)
stage.play(Create(Line(root.get_bottom(), ad.get_top())), Create(Line(root.get_bottom(), ch.get_top())), FadeIn(ad), FadeIn(ch))
stage.add(ad, ch)
stage.label(ad, "adults", direction=LEFT, color=BLUE)
stage.label(ch, "children", direction=RIGHT, color=ORANGE)

beats.intent: Each splits again by glasses: adults 45 yes, 75 no; children 20 yes, 60 no
beats.narration: Of the adults, forty five wear glasses and seventy five don't. Of the children, twenty do and sixty don't.
beats.code:
leaves = VGroup()
for parent, vals, x in ((ad, ("45", "75"), (-5.9, -4.1)), (ch, ("20", "60"), (-2.3, -0.5))):
    for v, xx, col in zip(vals, x, (GREEN, GREY_B)):
        leaf = node(v, [xx, -1.3, 0], col)
        stage.play(Create(Line(parent.get_bottom(), leaf.get_top())), FadeIn(leaf), run_time=0.5)
        stage.add(leaf)
        leaves.add(leaf)
stage.play(FadeIn(Text("glasses", font_size=22, color=GREEN).move_to([-5.9, -1.95, 0])), FadeIn(Text("glasses", font_size=22, color=GREEN).move_to([-2.3, -1.95, 0])))

beats.narration: Add the two glasses ends: sixty five of the two hundred, so the chance a random person wears glasses is nought point three two five.

request: how do you read a pictogram where each cup stands for 4 drinks?

beats.intent: A pictogram of drinks sold Monday to Thursday, with a key: one cup = 4 drinks
beats.narration: A café draws a pictogram of drinks sold. The key says each cup stands for four drinks.
beats.code:
stage.title("Reading a pictogram")
cup = lambda p: Circle(radius=0.22, color=ORANGE, fill_opacity=0.8).move_to(p)
half = lambda p: AnnularSector(inner_radius=0, outer_radius=0.22, angle=PI, start_angle=PI / 2, color=ORANGE, fill_opacity=0.8).move_arc_center_to(p)
data = (("Mon", 3), ("Tue", 4.5), ("Wed", 2), ("Thu", 3.5))
rows = VGroup()
for r, (day, n) in enumerate(data):
    y = 1.6 - 0.75 * r
    icons = VGroup(Text(day, font_size=26).move_to([-5.8, y, 0]), *[cup([-4.9 + 0.6 * i, y, 0]) for i in range(int(n))])
    if n % 1:
        icons.add(half([-4.9 + 0.6 * int(n), y, 0]))
    rows.add(icons)
stage.play(LaggedStart(*[FadeIn(r) for r in rows], lag_ratio=0.2))
stage.add(rows)
key = VGroup(cup([-4.9, -1.6, 0]), Text("= 4 drinks", font_size=26).move_to([-3.8, -1.6, 0]))
stage.play(FadeIn(key))
stage.add(key)

beats.intent: A half cup picked out: half an icon means 2 drinks
beats.narration: A half cup means half of four: two drinks.
beats.code:
hc = rows[1][-1]
ring = Circle(radius=0.35, color=YELLOW).move_to([-4.9 + 0.6 * 4, 1.6 - 0.75, 0])
stage.play(Create(ring))
stage.add(ring)
lh = stage.label(ring, "half = 2", direction=RIGHT, color=YELLOW)

beats.intent: Tuesday's row read off: 4½ cups = 18 drinks
beats.narration: So Tuesday is four and a half cups: four times four plus two, eighteen drinks.
beats.code:
stage.play(FadeOut(lh))
box = SurroundingRectangle(VGroup(rows[1], ring), color=GREEN, buff=0.08)
stage.play(Create(box))
stage.add(box)
stage.label(box, "Tue: 18", direction=RIGHT, color=GREEN)

beats.narration: Read every row the same way: twelve, eighteen, eight and fourteen. Fifty two drinks in four days.

request: a bag has 3 red, 5 blue and 2 green balls: what's the chance of red or blue?

beats.intent: A bag with 10 balls: 3 red, 5 blue, 2 green
beats.narration: A bag holds ten balls: three red, five blue and two green. Pick one without looking.
beats.code:
stage.title("Red or blue?")
bag = RoundedRectangle(width=4.2, height=2.6, corner_radius=0.4, color=GREY_B).move_to([-3.5, 0.0, 0])
cols = [RED] * 3 + [BLUE] * 5 + [GREEN] * 2
balls = VGroup(*[Circle(radius=0.28, color=col, fill_opacity=0.85).move_to([-5.0 + 0.7 * (i - (0 if i < 3 else 3 if i < 8 else 8)), 0.75 - 0.75 * (0 if i < 3 else 1 if i < 8 else 2), 0]) for i, col in enumerate(cols)])
stage.play(Create(bag), FadeIn(balls))
stage.add(bag, balls)

beats.intent: The 3 red balls ringed: 3 out of 10
beats.narration: Three of the ten are red: a chance of three tenths.
beats.code:
reds = SurroundingRectangle(VGroup(*balls[:3]), color=RED, buff=0.08)
stage.play(Create(reds))
stage.add(reds)
stage.label(bag, "red: 3/10", direction=UP, color=RED)

beats.intent: The 5 blue balls ringed separately: 5 out of 10, no ball in both rings
beats.narration: Five are blue: five tenths. No ball is both red and blue, so the two groups never overlap.
beats.code:
blues = SurroundingRectangle(VGroup(*balls[3:8]), color=BLUE, buff=0.08)
stage.play(Create(blues))
stage.add(blues)
stage.label(bag, "blue: 5/10", direction=DOWN, color=BLUE)

beats.intent: The bag beside P(red or blue) = 3/10 + 5/10 = 8/10
beats.narration: When two things can't both happen, add their chances: eight tenths. Check: only the two green balls are left out.
